build.already_applied: The tag resolves to an image whose prevention effect-id label equals effect_id.
build.effect_identity: effect_id plus image tag plus pre-execution image id plus build-context source hash
build.implementation_requirement: Pass a prevention effect-id label to docker build.
build.indeterminate: The tag resolves to a different image without the expected effect-id label.
build.not_applied: The tag is absent or still resolves to the prepared pre-execution image id.

copy-code-project.already_applied: The final destination has the expected effect receipt and source hash.
copy-code-project.effect_identity: effect_id plus container id plus source repository key and source hash plus destination
copy-code-project.implementation_requirement: Copy into an effect-specific staging directory, perform all git configuration there, write an effect receipt, then atomically rename into the final destination.
copy-code-project.indeterminate: A staging directory, conflicting destination, or mismatched receipt exists.
copy-code-project.not_applied: Neither final receipt nor effect staging directory exists.

run.already_applied: The named container exists with the expected effect-id label and declared image and port binding.
run.effect_identity: effect_id plus requested container name plus prepared pre-execution container id
run.implementation_requirement: Reject an existing same-name container unless it carries the local-workflow-orch-image owner label; record any accepted prior container id before removal; pass owner and prevention effect-id labels to docker run.
run.indeterminate: The name is occupied by a container without the expected effect-id label.
run.not_applied: The accepted prepared container still exists, or its authorized removal completed but no replacement container exists; replay can safely create the labeled replacement.

seed-codex-auth.already_applied: A live, non-secret Codex no-tool probe returns the exact approved OK marker.
seed-codex-auth.effect_identity: effect_id plus container id plus Key Vault name handle; no secret material
seed-codex-auth.indeterminate: Credential files exist but the live probe does not prove usable authentication.
seed-codex-auth.not_applied: Required credential/config files are definitively absent.

seed-git-auth.already_applied: The restarted service is healthy, uses GitRemoteManager, and a non-mutating authenticated URL acquisition probe succeeds for repository_key without emitting credentials.
seed-git-auth.effect_identity: effect_id plus container id plus Key Vault name handle plus repository key
seed-git-auth.indeterminate: Files exist but health, manager type, or authenticated acquisition is not proven.
seed-git-auth.not_applied: Required GitHub App configuration or PEM files are definitively absent.

stop.already_applied: The prepared container id no longer exists.
stop.effect_identity: effect_id plus prepared container id and name
stop.implementation_requirement: Reject a same-name container that lacks the local-workflow-orch-image owner label before removal.
stop.indeterminate: The name now refers to a different container id.
stop.not_applied: The prepared container id still exists under the prepared name.

by_command.build: JSON ok is true, imageTag equals the request, and docker inspect proves the expected effect-id label.
by_command.copy-code-project: JSON ok is true and non-mutating container checks prove the receipt, source hash, safe-directory entries, and local origin value.
by_command.health: JSON ok is true, port agrees with the request or port file, and health.status is exactly ok.
by_command.logs: docker logs succeeds; the owner emits a structured envelope containing ok=true and a hash of captured log bytes, never success after an ignored Docker error.
by_command.probe-codex: JSON ok is true; exactly the noTool and tool probes exist; both return code zero and each output matches its exact approved OK marker.
by_command.require-real-memory-knowledge: JSON ok and realMemoryKnowledge are both true.
by_command.run: JSON ok is true; container id/name, requested and actual ports, image tag, port-file value, and docker inspect label/binding all agree.
by_command.seed-codex-auth: seedResult.codex is exactly seeded or skipped (local is newer), contains no error or skipped-empty state, and the exact live Codex OK probe passes.
by_command.seed-git-auth: All required seed results are seeded, exists, or seeded+enriched; restart is true; health.status is ok; GitRemoteManager and authenticated acquisition probes pass without credential output.
by_command.stop: The prepared container id is absent; the owner never emits removed=true solely because docker rm was attempted.

common: Exactly one command-specific semantic verifier passes.
Exactly one durable owner_terminal event and one matching terminal artifact are emitted for effect_id.
A duplicate identical terminalization returns the existing event; a conflicting or second event fails closed.
